summary: Code review of tests/DOM/CallbackTest.php, DomTreeTest.php, and MiscTest.php. All three files are clean, well-structured, and consistent with the WP-001 established pattern (ElementTest.php). No blocking issues found. Four low-priority non-blocking observations recorded. All 5 AC met.

comments.note:
CallbackTest.php: the HTML fixture string '

foo

' is repeated verbatim in all 5 test methods. Extracting it to a private class constant or a $this->fixture property set in setUp() would reduce duplication and make future changes to the fixture trivial.

DomTreeTest.php::testAttributeRemoval — Sequences 1 and 2 are byte-for-byte identical (same HTML load, same attribute removals, same assertions). Intent was likely to test two different removal orders. No correctness harm, but the duplicate sequence wastes test time and is a maintenance red flag. A future cleanup should differentiate the two sequences.

DomTreeTest.php::testCamelCaseDomApi — The assertion `$e->getAttribute('checked') == true` uses loose equality. Since getAttribute() returns a string ('checked'), this is truthy but not strict. Prefer `$this->assertNotEmpty($e->getAttribute('checked'))` or `$this->assertSame('checked', $e->getAttribute('checked'))` to avoid masking a type-level regression.

MiscTest.php::testErrorTagHandling — creates a local $dom via str_get_html() and manually calls $dom->clear() instead of assigning to $this->dom to leverage tearDown(). Not a bug (clear() is called), but slightly inconsistent with the class lifecycle pattern used by the other two test methods.
